description: Transactions admitted or refused by the topic manager's rules (docs/spec.md section 8.1), in the order given there. Each case is the transaction as raw hex and as the BEEF submitted (Atomic BEEF unless the case says otherwise: an unmined transaction's with its ancestry to a mined parent, a mined transaction's with its own proof and no parents), and the previous coins it is admitted with: the inputs that spend an output the topic holds once the admitted cases are admitted, as the overlay engine hands them to the topic manager (inputIndex), each with the outpoint it spends (txid in display order). Admission runs against the office and the headers below, with a BEEF bound of maxBeef bytes. A refusal is raised, never answered with empty instructions. admits lists the admittance instructions (outputsToAdmit, coinsToRetain) and what the lookup service records: a carrier's commitment (hash byte order), record, owner and funding outpoint, and a sweep's spent outpoints. scriptsVerify says every input of the transaction passes the script interpreter against the output it spends, so the engine's SPV does not refuse a case for its scripts: each refusal is made by the rule the case names and by no earlier one. rule names the frozen-list row a refusal exercises. Signatures are deterministic (RFC 6979), so the bytes are reproducible.
fundKeyNote: fee coins pay P2PKH to each identity's [1, "bbox message"] key id fund under counterparty self, the embedded wallet's funding key; no admission rule reads which key a fee coin pays
headersNote: merkleRoot is in display byte order, as a txid is printed

transactions.name: carrier-envelope-note
transactions.note: the envelope-note record's carrier, spending sender funding-tree output 0; that output is held (the published funding tree admitted it), so the carrier retains it

transactions.name: carrier-envelope-refs
transactions.note: the envelope-refs record's carrier, spending sender funding-tree output 1

transactions.name: carrier-envelope-payment
transactions.note: the payment envelope's carrier (payment-v1.json), spending sender funding-tree output 2; a host sees only the record

transactions.name: carrier-receipt
transactions.note: the recipient's receipt acknowledging carrier-envelope-note and carrier-envelope-refs, spending recipient funding-tree output 0

transactions.name: carrier-beef-v1
transactions.note: carrier-envelope-note submitted as BEEF V1 (BRC-62) rather than Atomic BEEF: the same two transactions and one proof

transactions.name: carrier-locktime-max
transactions.note: the envelope-note record on the same funding output under nLockTime 0xFFFFFFFF and nSequence 0xFFFFFFFE: any locktime from 2100 and any non-final sequence is admitted, and a second carrier on one funding output is admitted and left to the index to supersede

transactions.name: funding-tree
transactions.note: the sender's funding tree, published after it mined: output 0 is funding-shaped, so it is admitted as a sweep would be, and its input's outpoint is recorded

transactions.name: sweep
transactions.note: a mined sweep of sender funding-tree outputs 0 and 1: its tombstone, output 0, is admitted and both outpoints are recorded, which retracts carrier-envelope-note and carrier-envelope-refs; it spends the held output 0 of the published funding tree, which it retains

transactions.name: spend-tombstone
transactions.note: an unmined transaction spending the sweep's tombstone, which the topic holds: it claims nothing and is not a sweep, so it admits nothing and retains the tombstone

transactions.name: carrier-two-inputs
transactions.note: carrier-envelope-note's output with a second funding input

transactions.name: carrier-two-outputs
transactions.note: the record output with 999 and a second output of 1

transactions.name: carrier-value-short
transactions.note: the one output carries 999 of the input's 1000

transactions.name: carrier-two-claiming-outputs
transactions.note: one output claims an envelope and another a receipt

transactions.name: carrier-beef-tree-unproven
transactions.note: carrier-envelope-note (the same txid) with its funding tree unproven, so its BEEF also carries the tree's mined parent: SPV passes, and the carrier is refused rather than recorded, so this BEEF cannot suppress the genuine one

transactions.name: carrier-beef-proof-extra-leaf
transactions.note: carrier-envelope-note (the same txid) with its funding tree proven by a path that also holds a leaf the proof does not need

transactions.name: carrier-beef-extra-transaction
transactions.note: carrier-envelope-note's BEEF with an unrelated mined transaction and its proof riding along

transactions.name: carrier-beef-no-funding-tree
transactions.note: carrier-envelope-note's BEEF without its funding tree: the value the input spends cannot be read

transactions.name: carrier-beef-before-record
transactions.note: breaks the beef rule (funding tree unproven) and the record rules (created 0): refused for the BEEF

transactions.name: carrier-record-refused
transactions.note: the envelope record has created 0; the record's own rules refuse it before any later rule

transactions.name: carrier-receipt-record-refused
transactions.note: a receipt acknowledging one commitment twice

transactions.name: carrier-other-office
transactions.note: a well-formed envelope carrier whose record names another office than the topic's

transactions.name: carrier-receipt-other-office
transactions.note: a well-formed receipt carrier whose record names another office

transactions.name: carrier-office-before-mineable
transactions.note: breaks the office rule and the mineable rule (a final input): refused for the office

transactions.name: carrier-locktime-below
transactions.note: nLockTime one second before 2100

transactions.name: carrier-final-input
transactions.note: the input's nSequence is 0xFFFFFFFF

transactions.name: carrier-mineable-before-unlock
transactions.note: nLockTime one second before 2100 and the signature pushed by OP_PUSHDATA1: refused as mineable

transactions.name: carrier-unlock-high-s
transactions.note: carrier-envelope-note with its input signature's high-S twin, which verifies: another txid, same record

transactions.name: carrier-unlock-pushdata1
transactions.note: carrier-envelope-note with its signature pushed by OP_PUSHDATA1

transactions.name: carrier-unlock-extra-push
transactions.note: carrier-envelope-note with OP_0 pushed before its signature

transactions.name: carrier-unlock-sighash-single
transactions.note: the input signed SIGHASH_SINGLE|FORKID (0x43), which verifies

transactions.name: carrier-unlock-sighash-anyonecanpay
transactions.note: the input signed SIGHASH_ALL|ANYONECANPAY|FORKID (0xc1), which verifies

transactions.name: carrier-unlock-before-lock
transactions.note: breaks the lock rule (record output under the signature key) and the unlock rule (signature pushed by OP_PUSHDATA1): refused for the unlocking script

transactions.name: carrier-lock-signature-key
transactions.note: the record output locked and signed under the sender's key for key id signature, not envelope

transactions.name: carrier-lock-recipient-key
transactions.note: the sender's record locked and signed under the recipient's envelope key: the lock is bound to the record's from

transactions.name: carrier-lock-non-minimal-push
transactions.note: the record pushed with OP_PUSHDATA4 where OP_PUSHDATA2 is minimal; same fields, same signature

transactions.name: carrier-lock-drop-drop
transactions.note: OP_DROP OP_DROP where OP_2DROP is the fewest

transactions.name: carrier-lock-unsigned
transactions.note: the record output carries no field signature

transactions.name: carrier-lock-extra-field
transactions.note: a third push after the record and its signature, dropped canonically

transactions.name: carrier-lock-trailing-opcode
transactions.note: the canonical script followed by OP_NOP

transactions.name: carrier-field-signature-high-s
transactions.note: the field signature's high-S twin, which verifies; the script is otherwise canonical (bcommon carrier.Validate alone accepts it)

transactions.name: carrier-field-signature-wrong-key
transactions.note: a strict signature over the record by the third identity's key

transactions.name: carrier-field-signature-identity-key
transactions.note: a strict signature over the record by the sender's identity key rather than its envelope key

transactions.name: carrier-funding-bare-p2pk
transactions.note: spends a bare pay-to-public-key output under the sender's envelope key instead of a funding output

transactions.name: carrier-funding-signature-key
transactions.note: spends a funding-shaped output locked to the sender's signature key

transactions.name: carrier-funding-signed-tag
transactions.note: spends an output under the envelope key whose one field is the funding tag with a field signature

transactions.name: carrier-funding-other-tag
transactions.note: spends an output under the envelope key whose one field is 62 62 03

transactions.name: carrier-content-white-space
transactions.note: a carrier whose record is refusal-v1.json's content-white-space: every carrier rule holds, and the content rules refuse it

transactions.name: carrier-content-payment-object
transactions.note: a carrier whose record is refusal-v1.json's content-payment-object: every carrier rule holds, and the content rules refuse it

transactions.name: carrier-content-cipher-wrong-recipient
transactions.note: a carrier whose record is refusal-v1.json's content-cipher-wrong-recipient: every carrier rule holds, and the content rules refuse it

transactions.name: carrier-content-signature-identity-key
transactions.note: a carrier whose record is refusal-v1.json's content-signature-identity-key: every carrier rule holds, and the content rules refuse it

transactions.name: funding-tree-unmined
transactions.note: the sender's funding tree with no proof

transactions.name: sweep-unmined
transactions.note: the sweep with no proof: nothing unmined retracts

transactions.name: sweep-proof-unknown-height
transactions.note: the sweep with a proof at a height the headers do not hold

transactions.name: sweep-tombstone-second
transactions.note: a mined spend of funding-tree output 4 whose funding-shaped output is output 1, not 0: it claims nothing, is not a sweep and spends nothing held

transactions.name: sweep-tombstone-pushdata1
transactions.note: a mined spend of funding-tree output 5 whose output 0 pushes the funding tag with OP_PUSHDATA1: not a well-formed funding output

transactions.name: spend-not-held
transactions.note: spend-tombstone offered with no previous coins: the topic does not hold what it spends
